content.text:
Create a realistic Chinese historical live-action movie scene. 16:9 full frame, restrained low saturation, natural skin, soft firelight, detailed dark canvas and worn iron armour. The camera is the visitor's eyes: no visitor body, shoulder, face, reflection or permanent spear in foreground. Not an over-the-shoulder shot. Audio: ONLY speak the Chinese sentences inside quotation marks below. Never read any directions, names, identifiers, labels or English text. No subtitles, no text, no music. Other sounds: wind, canvas, clothes and steps synchronized to the scene. Keep the same face, costume, camp location and screen direction between shots. All unquoted text is silent direction.
Picture 1: 甲, 只锁甲的中年宽脸、黑布包髻、短须与旧铁札甲，不复制背景及画风.
Picture 2: 中军帐, 只锁中军大帐、闭帘、门侧火盆、右侧告示、土路及木栏的空间；时段按分镜.
0-10 seconds. 甲仍在同一守位，先轻指营道，再收手；把急报和禁令两件事说完整，最后说明自己不能处置军情。 与G09A同眼线65mm中近景，台词后留0.7秒自然余量。
Only the on-screen 甲 speaks to the unseen visitor: "急报得赶紧送到，禁令也不能擅改。". Other people stay silent with closed lips.
Only the on-screen 甲 speaks to the unseen visitor: "我只能守门递话，不能处置军情。". Other people stay silent with closed lips.

Finish every quoted sentence in order. End with 0.4 seconds of quiet. Do not add any spoken words.
